title: Model picker storage paths
responsibility: Computes the picker state and provider catalog locations from environment overrides or the user’s Codex directory.

outputs.name: pickerPaths
outputs.description: Picker home from HARNESS_PICKER_HOME or CODEX_HOME/harness/picker, plus OpenAI models_cache.json and Harness Claude catalog paths under CODEX_HOME. Without CODEX_HOME, the root is the user home .codex directory. No directories are created or files read.
